Kaviar.et: Borrowed from Venetan caviaro, ultimately from Classical Persian خَاوْیَار (xāwyār). See English caviar for more.

Kavalier.et:
Borrowed from Italian cavalier, from Old French chevalier, from Late Latin caballārius (“horse rider”).
Early loans into Middle High German, as cavali(e)r, are recorded for the 14th century, but remained without direct continuants.
